findings.text: Google Ads produced only 2 conversions on $1,949.23 spend (28d) — $974.62 cost-per-conversion vs Meta's $50.99 CPL on 36 leads.
6 SOW milestones overdue since Jul–Sep 2026: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/LPs Live, Ads Launch, Meta Retargeting Launch, Shoot 1 — no completion events recorded.
GHL shows 105 opportunities created from 320 contacts but 0 won and 0 appointments — leads are entering the pipeline and dying there.
3-day lead signal (Oct 27–29): 5 leads on $360.49 spend vs prior 3 days (Oct 24–26): 3 leads on $360.91 — Meta volume holding, not accelerating.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 on Oct 27–29 after averaging ~5/day earlier in October — local organic visibility may have dropped or profile data is lagging.

suggestions.text: Shift $15/day from Google Search to Meta — Google's $974.62 CPL vs Meta's $50.99 makes this non-negotiable.
suggestions.monday_update: Move $15/day from Google Ads (Leads - Search Campaign) to Meta, effective immediately. Google Ads generated only 2 conversions on $1,949.23 over 28 days ($974.62 CPL) while Meta delivered 36 leads at $50.99 CPL on $1,835.81. Success check: Meta CPL stays below $120 (client series baseline) and Google conversion rate shows measurable improvement within 14 days, otherwise reduce Google further. Re-evaluate by 2026-11-13.

suggestions.text: Escalate GHL intake leak: 105 opps, 0 appointments, 0 won — audit routing and speed-to-lead compliance now.
